item.title: ICAI sets Guinness World Record with Largest Career Guidance Session for Youth in Mumbai
item.description: ICAI’s Guinness World Record for the largest career guidance session marks a milestone in educational outreach. By engaging over 6,000 students in structured, future-focused counselling, the institute has reaffirmed its commitment to youth empowerment and national development through commerce education.

item.title: GST Notices Cannot be Deemed Served only by Portal Upload after Cancellation of Registration: Allahabad HC says its Natural Justice Violation [Read Order]
item.description: The court found that serving a show cause notice solely through a portal upload subsequent to the cancellation, and without alternative means of service, constituted a violation of the principle of natural justice.

item.title: GST SCN Properly Uploaded, No Reply Filed: Delhi HC Declines Interference in Fraudulent ITC Case [Read Order]
item.description: The Court has declined to entertain a writ petition filed by the petitioner challenging a GST demand order, holding that fraudulent Input Tax Credit (ITC) cases require factual adjudication and cannot be decided in writ jurisdiction.

item.title: When Dept Admits No Service Tax Liability, It cannot Deny Refund of Deposit made during Investigation on Limitation: Chhattisgarh HC [Read Order]
item.description: The Chhattisgarh High Court held that once the Department admits no service tax was payable, it cannot use limitation or procedural lapses to deny refund of the amount deposited during investigation

item.title: Haryana Excise Dept issues Instructions on Initiating Suo-Moto Audit/Scrutiny Cases
item.description: Haryana Excise & Taxation Department issued strict new instructions mandating justified reasons and multi-level approval before initiating any suo-moto audit or scrutiny under the HGST Act, 2017.

item.title: CAAR Rejects Skoda’s EV Parts Classification Request Due to Pending Bombay HC Litigation [Read Order]
